steps.note: Open the prepared closed eRFX RFQ project's summary page.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the buyer session.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Confirm the recreate-order flow presents its Create Order action.
Keep the defaults and create the recreated order.
Verify that the flow reaches the new event creation screen.
Confirm the recreated event flow did not show an application error.
